senses.gloss: f.(b. h. בַּצֹּרֶת, בַּצָּרָה; בצר)scarcity of provision, dearth.
units: <cite ref="Pirkei Avot 5:8">Ab. V, 8</cite> <he>רעב של ב׳ וכ׳</he> a famine in consequence of high prices, when some are hungry, others are satisfied, <he>רעב של מהומה ושל ב׳</he> a famine through political disturbances and through dearth.
<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 33:3">Gen. R. s. 33</cite> <he>שנת ב׳</he> a year of dearth.
<cite ref="Taanit 19b:1">ib. 19ᵇ</cite> <he>מכה המביאה לידי ב׳</he> a calamity which will produce dearth (want of rain in season).
